method.order: sequential; rotate build order on successive rounds
method.clock: time.monotonic; PTY receipt before terminal emulation
method.completion: tcell cursor boundary, exact table count, expected visible row prefix
method.metric: Enter applies a prepared filter to completed matching table frame; startup recorded separately
method.limits: Includes terminal output and scheduling. Not monitor paint latency or an isolated CPU benchmark.

video.selection: nearest sample to each operation/build median, independently
video.sample_alignment: input timestamp is zero for all panels; 1-second pre-input hold; completed panels hold their final screen

benchmark_card.scope: Separate CPU microbenchmarks; excludes API and terminal I/O; not overall app speed
